protocol.routing: score(x) = energy(x) if snr <= 0 dB else prototype(x)
protocol.tau: 95.0th percentile of known-pool scores (5% FRR operating point; no unknown data used for tau)
protocol.pooling: pair-weighted across SNR bins (n_known*n_unknown), same convention as the paper

variants.A: split-half 50/50 stratified by SNR, raw stored scores
variants.B: headline: prototypes refit on held-out reference pool (seed 88888), tau calibrated on the reference pool; energy not calibratable there (no logits) — omitted
variants.C: split-half, per-scorer known-ECDF rank normalization before routing; single scorers decision-identical to A
